Presenting this elegant and spacious 1-bedroom furnished apartment in the prestigious Limestone House, located in the heart of DIFC.

Designed for comfortable city living, this residence offers a bright and well-balanced layout with generous proportions throughout. The unit is fully furnished and situated in one of Dubai’s most sought-after business and lifestyle destinations, providing residents with unmatched connectivity and access to world-class dining, retail, and entertainment options.

Property Features:
- 1 Bed
- 1 Bath
- Fully Furnished
- 1,299.9 sq. ft.
- Spacious Layout
- Built-in Wardrobes
- Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
- Bright Natural Light
- Prime DIFC Location
- High-End Residential Building
- Easy Access to Downtown Dubai & Sheikh Zayed Road

Ideal for professionals or end-users seeking a premium address in a central location.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
